10329.description: 大重量、高次数的单臂划船，允许少量身体借力，对背阔肌和握力很有帮助。
steps: 站在长凳一侧，一侧手和膝撑在凳上，另一只手握一只较重的哑铃。
让哑铃自然下垂，感受背阔肌被拉伸。
借助可控的惯性把哑铃划向髋部。
缓慢下放至完全拉伸。
全程保持背部平直。完成次数后换另一侧手臂。

en.description: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
steps: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

1047.description: 窄握的高位下拉，把横杆拉到上胸部，锻炼背阔肌和肱二头肌。
steps: 坐在下拉器械上，将大腿固定在护垫下。
窄握横杆。
身体稍向后仰，把横杆拉到上胸部。
手肘向下发力，收紧背阔肌。
让横杆缓慢回升，直到手臂伸直。

en.description: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

1204.description: 在高位滑轮上做单臂下拉，让两侧背阔肌分别独立发力。
steps: 在高位滑轮上装单手把手，面向配重片坐下。
单手握住把手，坐直。
将把手拉到胸部侧面，手肘朝髋部方向发力。
稍作停顿，然后让手臂缓慢回升。
完成次数后换另一侧。

en.description: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
steps: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

1503.description: 在身前把弹力带向两侧拉开的简单动作，强化上背部和三角肌后束，有助于改善体态。
steps: 双手在身前肩高处握住弹力带，手臂伸直。
肋骨下沉，肩膀远离耳朵。
双手向两侧移动，把弹力带拉开。
动作末端收紧肩胛骨。
有控制地缓慢还原。

en.description: A simple band move pulling the arms apart in front of you. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders and helps posture.
steps: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly with control.

2291.description: 宽握的高位下拉，用于发展上背部宽阔的肌群。
steps: 坐在下拉器械上，将大腿固定在护垫下。
正手宽握横杆。
身体稍向后仰，把横杆拉到上胸部。
手肘向下、向后发力，夹紧肩胛骨。
控制横杆回升，直到手臂完全伸展。
避免躯干前后摆动。

en.description: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid swinging your torso.

3896.description: 用弹力带进行的坐姿划船，锻炼中背部和背阔肌。
steps: 坐在地上双腿伸直，把弹力带套在脚上。
双手握住弹力带两端，手臂伸直。
坐直，挺胸。
手肘向后拉，夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢伸直手臂。
肩膀保持远离耳朵。

en.description: A seated row with a band that works the mid back and lats.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

6156.description: 使用壶铃的俯身划船，锻炼背阔肌和中背部。
steps: 手握壶铃，保持背部平直、以髋为轴向前俯身。
手臂自然垂直向下。
将壶铃划向髋部。
把肩胛骨向后收紧。
缓慢下放。
完成次数后换另一侧手臂。

en.description: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.
steps: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1162.description: 严格的杠铃站姿过头推举，增强肩部和肱三头肌力量。
steps: 在肩高处将杠铃出架，双手握距略宽于肩。
站直，双脚与髋同宽，收紧臀部。
把杠铃垂直向上推起，头部先略微后让、再回到杠铃下方。
在头顶锁定，杠铃位于足中上方。
有控制地把杠铃下放回锁骨位置。

en.description: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
steps: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

1200.description: 借助腿部快速下蹲和蹬伸完成的过头推举，可以用更大重量训练肩部和肱三头肌。
steps: 将杠铃置于上胸部，手肘略在杠铃前方。
屈膝下沉几厘米，躯干保持直立。
双腿向上蹬伸，顺势把杠铃推过头顶。
锁定时杠铃位于足中上方，然后放回胸前。
核心收紧，避免身体后仰。

en.description: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

2921.description: 抬高臀部的俯卧撑，发力方向更接近过头推，只用自身体重即可增强肩部力量。
steps: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双脚向手的方向走近，抬高臀部形成倒 V 字。
手臂和背部保持伸直。
屈肘，使头顶朝地面下降。
推起直到手臂伸直。
全程收紧核心。

en.description: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.
steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

3914.description: 在绳索器械上大开肘的划船，主练三角肌后束。
steps: 将绳索调到胸部高度，装上把手或绳索。
手臂伸直握住。
向后退一步，身体稍微后倾。
手肘向外张开，把把手拉向上胸部。
收紧三角肌后束。
缓慢还原。

en.description: A row with wide elbows on the cable machine that targets the rear delts.
steps: Set a cable at chest height with a handle or rope.
Hold it with your arms extended.
Step back and lean slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts.
Return slowly.

5607.description: 用弹力带做的面拉，锻炼三角肌后束和上背部。
steps: 把弹力带固定在头部高度，握住两端。
向后退步，让弹力带产生张力。
手肘抬高，把弹力带拉向面部。
夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢还原。

en.description: Face pull using a band to train the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

5609.description: 绳索面拉，发展三角肌后束并强化上背部。
steps: 将绳索调到上胸部高度，装上把手。
站直，向面部方向拉。
动作末端双手向两侧分开。
夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢还原。

en.description: Cable face pull to build the rear delts and strengthen the upper back.
steps: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

0781.description: 前后分腿站立的下蹲，后脚位置固定不动，单侧分别锻炼股四头肌和臀部。
steps: 一脚在前一脚在后，大步距站立。
躯干直立，核心收紧。
双膝同时弯曲下蹲，直到后侧膝盖接近地面。
前脚脚跟发力站起。
完成全部次数后换腿。

en.description: A staggered-stance squat where the back leg stays put. It works the quads and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and the other back.
Keep your torso upright and core tight.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

1060.description: 上背靠在凳上、杠铃横放在髋部的臀桥，是练出强壮臀部的首选动作。
steps: 坐在地上，上背部靠在长凳边缘，将加了护垫的杠铃放在髋部上方。
双脚与髋同宽踩实，用脚跟发力。
抬起髋部，直到躯干与地面平行。
顶端收紧臀部，下巴微收。
有控制地放下髋部。
重复动作，避免下背部过度弓起。

en.description: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

1206.description: 背对低位绳索做的髋铰链动作，锻炼臀部和腘绳肌，也有助于学会正确的屈髋模式。
steps: 在低位滑轮装上绳索，背对配重片站立，从双腿之间握住绳索。
向前走到绳索绷紧，膝盖微屈。
臀部向后推，让绳索从双腿间向后移动。
髋部向前顶，收紧臀部站直。
全程保持背部平直。

en.description: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

1543.description: 经典的直腿硬拉，膝盖几乎伸直、以髋为轴屈身，很好地发展腘绳肌、臀部和下背部。
steps: 双脚与髋同宽站立，手握杠铃置于大腿前方。
膝盖保持微屈，臀部向后推。
让杠铃贴着腿下降，直到腘绳肌有明显拉伸感。
全程背部平直、挺胸。
髋部向前发力回到站立。

en.description: The classic stiff-legged deadlift, hinging at the hips with nearly straight knees. A great builder for hamstrings, glutes and the lower back.
steps: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your back flat and your chest proud the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

1595.description: 在史密斯机固定轨道上做的前蹲，以直立躯干锻炼股四头肌。
steps: 将杠铃调到肩高，置于肩部前侧，手肘抬起。
解锁杠铃，双脚略向前站。
下蹲至大腿约与地面平行。
手肘保持抬高，挺胸。
脚跟发力站起，完成后挂回杠铃。

en.description: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.
steps: Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.

1597.description: 使用史密斯机杠铃的直腿硬拉，固定轨道让你更专注于感受腘绳肌发力。
steps: 靠近史密斯机杠铃站立，双脚与髋同宽，正手握杠。
解锁杠铃，膝盖几乎伸直。
臀部向后推，让杠铃沿腿部下滑。
下降到腘绳肌有明显拉伸感。
收紧臀部站直。

en.description: A stiff-legged deadlift using the smith machine bar. The fixed path lets you focus on feeling the hamstrings work.
steps: Stand close to the smith bar with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand.
Unrack it and keep your knees nearly straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.

2072.description: 上背靠凳、抬起髋部的臀桥，专注于练出强壮的臀部。
steps: 坐在地上，上背部靠在长凳边缘，屈膝。
双脚平踩地面，与髋同宽。
脚跟发力抬起髋部，直到躯干与地面平行。
顶端收紧臀部。
缓慢放下并重复。

en.description: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2146.description: 臀推的器械版本，以固定运动轨迹为臀部加负荷。
steps: 坐上器械，上背部靠在靠垫上，把绑带横跨在髋部。
双脚平踩，约与髋同宽。
脚跟发力抬起髋部，直到躯干与大腿成一直线。
在顶端收紧臀部停留片刻。
有控制地下放并重复，下巴保持微收。

en.description: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.
steps: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.

2267.description: 坐姿器械腿举，有靠背支撑，通过向前蹬腿增强大腿和臀部力量。
steps: 调整座椅，坐好使背部紧贴靠垫。
双脚踩在踏板上，约与肩同宽。
脚跟发力蹬出，直到腿接近伸直。
不要锁死膝盖。
缓慢屈膝回到起始位置。
按计划次数重复。

en.description: A seated machine leg press that drives the legs forward to build thigh and glute strength with back support.
steps: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2290.description: 后脚垫高的单腿蹲，增强腿部力量和平衡能力。
steps: 双手各持一只哑铃，站在长凳前约一步距离处。
将后脚脚背搭在凳上。
垂直向下蹲，直到前侧大腿约与地面平行。
躯干直立，前膝与脚尖方向一致。
前脚脚跟发力站起。
完成全部次数后换腿。

en.description: A single-leg squat with the back foot raised, building leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

2471.description: 双脚着地的徒手臀桥，强化臀部和腘绳肌。
steps: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平踩地面。
双臂放在身体两侧。
脚跟发力抬起髋部。
使肩、髋、膝成一直线。
顶端收紧臀部。
缓慢放下并重复。

en.description: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3030.description: 杠铃扛在背上、前后分腿站立的下蹲，单侧分别训练双腿，增强力量和平衡。
steps: 将杠铃横放在上背部，一只脚向前迈出。
大步距站立，躯干直立。
双膝弯曲，后侧膝盖朝地面下降。
前脚脚跟不离地，前膝位于脚的正上方。
前脚发力站起。
完成次数后换腿。

en.description: A split-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It works each leg on its own and builds strength and balance.
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3322.description: 壶铃放在两脚之间的硬拉，适合新手，用于学习髋铰链并锻炼臀部和腘绳肌。
steps: 双脚与髋同宽站立，壶铃放在两脚之间。
臀部后推、屈膝，双手握住壶铃把手。
挺胸，背部平直。
双脚蹬地站直，收紧臀部。
以髋为轴俯身把壶铃放回地面，然后重复。

en.description: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

3335.description: 加负重的臀桥，针对臀部；把哑铃放在髋部上增加阻力。
steps: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平踩地面。
将哑铃横放在髋部上并扶稳。
脚跟发力，把髋部向天花板方向抬起。
顶端用力收紧臀部。
缓慢放下髋部并重复。

en.description: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

3593.description: 经典杠铃深蹲，增强大腿和髋部力量。
steps: 将杠铃放在上背部，双脚与肩同宽站立。
收紧核心，挺胸。
臀部向后向下坐，直到大腿约与地面平行。
膝盖与脚尖方向一致。
双脚发力站直。

en.description: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

3948.description: 基础的徒手深蹲，增强腿部力量和灵活性。
steps: 双脚与肩同宽站立。
双臂向前伸以保持平衡。
臀部向后向下坐，直到大腿与地面平行。
保持挺胸。
双脚发力站起。

en.description: A basic bodyweight squat that builds leg strength and mobility.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

4295.description: 双手各持哑铃、一步接一步向前弓步，增强腿部、臀部力量和平衡。
steps: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃垂于体侧。
一条腿向前迈步，下蹲至双膝约成 90 度。
躯干直立，前膝位于脚踝正上方。
前脚发力，把后腿向前带出，迈入下一步。
两腿交替，完成预定步数。

en.description: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.

7589.description: 跪姿绳索后踢腿，孤立训练臀部。
steps: 在低位绳索上套脚踝绑带，面向器械呈四点跪姿。
收紧核心，背部平直。
把套着绑带的腿向后上方踢出。
在顶端收紧臀部。
缓慢还原。
完成全部次数后换另一侧。

en.description: A kneeling cable kickback that isolates the glutes.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7746.description: 跪姿、双脚固定，身体缓慢向前倒下，是强度很高的腘绳肌力量训练。
steps: 跪在垫子上，让脚踝被牢牢固定住。
从膝盖到头部保持一条直线。
尽可能缓慢地向前倒下。
到底部时用双手撑住。
推回起始位置并重复。

en.description: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.
steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.

0166.description: 使用低位绳索的锤式弯举，对握方式同时锻炼肱二头肌和前臂肌群。
steps: 在低位滑轮上装绳索或把手，掌心相对握住。
站直，手肘贴在身体两侧。
把把手向肩部方向弯举。
顶端收紧。
缓慢下放直到手臂伸直。
上臂保持不动，避免身体摆动。

en.description: A hammer-grip curl using a low cable. The neutral grip works the biceps and the forearm muscles together.
steps: Attach a rope or handle to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and avoid swinging.

0463.description: 经典的前臂平板支撑，保持从头到脚跟成一条直线，增强核心耐力和稳定性。
steps: 俯卧，用前臂撑起身体，手肘位于肩膀正下方。
抬起髋部和膝盖离地，用脚尖支撑。
身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
收紧腹部和臀部。
保持 20–60 秒，均匀呼吸。
不要塌腰或撅臀。

en.description: The classic forearm plank. Holding a straight line from head to heels builds core endurance and stability.
steps: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips and knees off the floor, resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your abs and glutes.
Hold for 20-60 seconds while breathing steadily.
Don't let your hips sag or pike up.

0715.description: 用单侧前臂支撑的侧向平板，增强腹斜肌和稳定躯干的肌群。
steps: 侧卧，手肘位于肩膀正下方，双腿并拢叠放。
抬起髋部，使身体从头到脚成一直线。
髋部保持抬高，颈部保持中立。
有控制地放下，然后换另一侧。
不要让髋部下沉或向前转。

en.description: A sideways plank balanced on one forearm. It builds strength in the obliques and the muscles that stabilise your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips high and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Don't let your hips drop or roll forward.

1163.description: 在地面上抬起伸直的双腿，针对下腹部的动作。
steps: 仰卧，双腿伸直，双手放在臀部下方。
下背部轻轻压向地面。
双腿并拢抬起，直到指向天花板。
缓慢放下，在离地面稍高处停住。
全程避免下背部弓起。

en.description: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

1202.description: 把绳索从胸前向正前方推出，同时抵抗被拉转的力量，训练核心的抗旋转能力。
steps: 将绳索调到胸部高度，身体侧对配重片站立。
双手在胸前握住把手，收紧核心。
把把手向正前方推出，直到手臂伸直。
保持一秒，躯干不要扭转。
收回胸前，完成一组后换另一侧。

en.description: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

1241.description: 四点跪姿下伸展对侧手臂和腿，增强核心控制和背部稳定性。
steps: 四点跪姿开始，双手在肩膀正下方，膝盖在髋部正下方。
右臂向前伸直，同时左腿向后伸直。
保持髋部水平、背部平直。
停留片刻后还原。
换另一侧，交替进行。

en.description: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

1246.description: 体操风格的静态支撑，肩部和双腿同时离地，增强深层核心力量。
steps: 仰卧，双臂伸过头顶，双腿伸直。
下背部压向地面。
将肩部和双腿抬离地面几厘米。
保持这个姿势，均匀呼吸。
保持 20–30 秒后休息。

en.description: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

3890.description: 悬垂抬腿的一种，膝盖上抬至触碰手肘，高强度锻炼腹部和髋屈肌。
steps: 双手牢固握住单杠悬垂。
收紧核心，屈膝。
把膝盖向手肘方向抬起。
顶端骨盆向上卷起。
缓慢放下，不要摆动。
重复至目标次数。

en.description: A hanging leg raise where the knees travel up to the elbows, working the abs and hip flexors hard.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

4093.description: 用墙挡住健腹轮的滚轮前推，是更安全的腹部和核心训练方式。
steps: 面对墙壁跪下，健腹轮放在身前地面上。
握住把手，骨盆后倾（卷尾骨）。
向前滚动，直到滚轮碰到墙面。
收缩腹部把滚轮拉回。
背部保持平直，避免髋部下塌。

en.description: An ab wheel rollout where a wall stops the wheel, making it a safer way to train your abs and core.
steps: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Grip the handles and tuck your pelvis under.
Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull the wheel back by contracting your abs.
Keep your back flat and avoid sagging at the hips.

5107.description: 在竖蹬架（罗马椅）上用前臂撑住身体抬腿，是经典的下腹训练动作。
steps: 前臂放在扶手垫上，背部紧贴靠垫。
双腿自然垂直向下。
屈膝或直腿抬起至髋部高度或更高。
在顶端稍作停顿。
缓慢放下双腿，不要摆动。

en.description: Raise your legs while supported by the arm pads of a captain's chair. It is a classic lower-ab exercise.
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

6211.description: 像蹬自行车一样的卷腹，每次将一侧手肘靠向对侧膝盖，锻炼腹直肌和腹斜肌。
steps: 仰卧，双手放在头部两侧。
抬起肩部，同时收起膝盖。
转体，使一侧手肘靠近对侧膝盖。
另一条腿伸直。
像蹬自行车一样左右交替。
下背部保持压在地面上。

en.description: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

8025.description: 双手持壶铃从高到低斜向穿过身体的转体劈砍，锻炼腹斜肌并发展旋转爆发力。
steps: 双手握住一只壶铃，双脚宽距站立。
起始时将壶铃举在一侧肩膀旁的高处。
转体并向下劈向对侧膝盖。
转身时后脚随之转动。
有控制地还原，然后换另一侧。

en.description: A rotational chop holding a kettlebell from high to low across the body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
steps: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.

8193.description: 从低到高斜向穿过身体的绳索劈砍，锻炼腹斜肌并发展旋转爆发力。
steps: 将绳索调到低位，身体侧对配重片站立。
双手握住把手。
沿对角线向上斜拉穿过身体。
后脚随之转动，躯干旋转。
缓慢还原。完成一组后换另一侧。

en.description: A cable chop that travels from low to high across your body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
steps: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

9819.description: 悬垂姿势下把膝盖抬向胸部，锻炼下腹部。
steps: 手臂伸直悬垂于单杠上。
收紧腹部，避免摆动。
把膝盖抬向胸部。
顶端骨盆向上后倾。
缓慢放下并重复。

en.description: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
